verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents automating workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations. Online evaluators run automatically on production traces, with filters and sampling rates. Threshold-based alerts on run count, cost, errors, feedback score, and latency route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP webhook. Together these give event- and condition-triggered automatic actions. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the automation-rules feature itself (available trigger conditions and action types such as adding traces to datasets or annotation queues), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
